title: Vallee hints Bob Lazar was an MK Ultra subject
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Vallee hints Bob Lazar was an MK Ultra subject, about 1980s-1990s at Las Vegas, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when he hints that Bob Lazar was actually an MK Ultra patient possibly the subject of government brainwashing which led him to believe he worked on reverse engineering UFOs

related.note: Both are about Bob Lazar's claim to have reverse-engineered UFOs at S4 in Nevada in the late 1980s. This telling, drawn from Vallee's book Revelations, explains that claim as the product of MK Ultra-style government brainwashing, not real work on alien craft, so the two accounts cannot both be right.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jacques Vallee, a longtime UFO researcher, hints in his book Revelations: Alien Contact and Human Deception that Bob Lazar, a man who claims he worked on reverse engineering alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, may have been a subject of MK Ultra, a secret US government mind-control programme. In that reading, government brainwashing could be what led Lazar to believe he had worked on UFOs, which would turn his famous story into a case of deliberate deception rather than alien technology.
